name: Mitani Rikuto
source: The protagonist of the series and a freshman at Asaoka high school. Is liked by everyone because of his kind personality, his mother passed away seven years ago and his father got remarried, later, he met his new little "brother"... In this way, Rikuto moved high school life begins...
